strategy.name: adaptive-native-menu-image-priority-v1
strategy.category_behavior: Priority index is recalculated against each filtered category list, so the visible first row of every category receives the same adaptive treatment.
strategy.renderer_behavior: The old blanket renderer replacement from bare menu img markup to loading=lazy no longer matches the LKG markup, so X-Rohmat-Public-Perf no longer reports menu-images-lazy.

asset_audit.note: This maintenance optimizes loading strategy only. Image file compression, format conversion, and visual content were intentionally not changed.

lkg.breakpoint_alignment: 881/561 mirrors inclusive CSS max-width 880/560 boundaries exactly.

live_validation.image_css_unchanged: 4:3 media frame with object-fit: contain; full/uncropped image policy preserved

post_change_rum.interpretation: These samples validate general load/regression safety; they are not presented as direct per-menu-image resource timing evidence.

dom_automation.fallback_evidence: Live Vercel HTML source plus deterministic matchMedia markup and external browser load samples were used.

protected_unmodified_dimensions: menu data, prices, categories and availability
menu image CSS and object-fit contain behavior
INP, CLS and CSS-stack source baselines
maintenance_rule: Future public maintenance must treat this adaptive 881/561 native loading strategy and the final LKG ETag as the latest menu-image-loading baseline unless a newer verified baseline explicitly supersedes it.
